newsitem.title: GREECE: Publisher Epiphania's IPO oversubscribed 23 times.
newsitem.headline: Publisher Epiphania's IPO oversubscribed 23 times.

text.p: Epiphania SA, a specialist in business publications and print communications, went public July 8-10 -- its IPO oversubscribed 23 times, lead underwriter Telesis Securities told Reuters on Thursday.
Epiphania, which designs and produces smart, upmarket business publications, is also active in multimedia and electronic marketing.
It tapped the capital market for 560 million drachmas with a public offering of 350,000 common bearer shares at 1,600 drachmas a share -- 9.7 times its 1996 pretax earnings.
The company also privately placed 17,500 shares bringing total proceeds to 588 million drachmas. After the IPO, Epiphania's total outstanding shares will be 2,367,500 -- its free float 15.5 percent.
Lead underwriter and issue advisor was Telesis Securities joined by co-underwriters National Bank Eurobank, Xiosbank, Alpha Brokerage, NIBID and N. Devletoglou Securities.
In 1996 Epiphania had sales of 1.64 billion drachmas and pretax profit of 289 million. It projects sales will grow to 1.8 billion this year and bring in pretax earnings of 330 million.
It sees sales in the first half of this year advancing 15 percent, contributing to a 20 percent growth in earnings.
Venture capital firm Baring Hellenic Ventures holds a 17.4 percent stake.
